title: Can There Be Friendship Without Self-Interest?
summary: An episode debating whether friendship rests on utility, pleasure, or a shared character, working through Aristotle's threefold distinction in the Nicomachean Ethics, al-Ghazali's etiquette of companionship (suhba), and the fellowship of the Akhi brotherhoods. Starting from the difference in Turkish between arkadaş (companion) and dost (true friend), it takes up why a person with hundreds of followers can find no one to call.
